requiredBehaviors.behavior: assess existing clinical performance evidence before deciding that a new study is needed
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The workflow inventories and assesses existing evidence before the Study-Need decision and permits no-new-study when evidence is sufficient.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: define claim-linked population specimen comparator endpoints bias controls statistics and risk references when a study is needed
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The design section requires claim, population, specimen, comparator/reference standard, endpoints, bias controls, sample-size/statistics and risk links.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: default automatically to a new clinical performance study
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The skill explicitly states that a new study is not an automatic default and first assesses Existing Evidence.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: treat the skill as generic operational study management
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The scope excludes generic study management, recruitment and autonomous patient-related operations.
